references.observations: Ordinary river-side panorama: five main haunched steel-girder spans with four tall battered cutwater-ended piers; long lower approach spans and smaller land piers; broad light roadside barrier and paired curved lamp poles. River bank/support details obscured by vegetation remain approximate.

Road view: four lanes, double solid center whites, dashed inner dividers, raised verge walks, dark open mesh outer fencing, low W guardrail and two curved lamp arms at different heights. No photo pixels copied.
